content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-courses-without-teachable-stripe-what-actually-how-6|COREMERCH guide to selling]] ebooks from Kenya without relying on Stripe or PayPal lies in building a sovereign digital commerce stack. This means using free and open-source tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. By doing so, you own your infrastructure and aren't at the mercy of platform restrictions. USDT on Tron, for instance, settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10, making it an ideal choice for international transactions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can start selling your ebooks, you need to have a few things in place. First, you need a digital wallet that can receive cryptocurrency payments. You also need to choose a payment processor like NOWPayments that can handle automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Additionally, you need to decide on a delivery method for your ebooks, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. With these components in place, you can start building your sovereign digital commerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is straightforward. You can use NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency payments, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to deliver your ebooks. You can also use Binance P2P to support local currencies like the Kenyan shilling. By integrating these components, you can create a seamless payment and delivery experience for your customers. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you get all the templates and blueprints you need to build and deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack.

Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live and start selling your ebooks. The first transaction is always the most exciting, and with your sovereign digital commerce stack in place, you can process it instantly and securely. You can use the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) to get started, which includes deployment in 48 hours and 30-day support. With this stack, you can load up to 3 products and start selling immediately.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your sales grow, you can scale your infrastructure to meet the demand. You can add more products, increase your storage, and even use more advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you get all the features you need to scale your business, including end-to-end testing and 30-day support. By scaling your infrastructure, you can continue to sell your ebooks to customers all over the world, without worrying about platform restrictions or payment processing issues.
